budget_tradeoff_detail: Skeleton and keep/drop representations resolve issues at roughly 27-38% fewer tokens than full source (6,876-8,629 vs 25,426 mean tokens) while matching or exceeding full-source resolve rate (32.9-35.7% vs 27.1%); NL summaries at ~180 tokens answer only 4/45 behavioral probes versus 27/45 for raw source at ~1,124 tokens (Table 2-3).

title: Agent Retrieval Bench: Evaluating Repository Context Retrieval for Coding Agents

key_numbers.metric: Budgeted Context Yield @8k: RepoMap vs Qwen3-4B vs Qwen3-8B

key_numbers.value: 427 samples, 25 repositories, 392,000 files / 7.9M chunks, 308 base-commit snapshots

budget_tradeoff_detail: Budgeted Context Yield (BCY@B) computed at B=4k/8k/16k/32k tokens; best method reverses with budget (Qwen3-4B leads at 4k, Qwen3-8B leads at 8k on edit2ripple), and RepoMap (structural, vectorless) achieves the best single-method BCY@8k while trailing on raw Recall@20/MRR.
confound_note: This is the study's central comparison: representation/mechanism (lexical BM25, structural RepoMap, five embedding models, logged agentic Codex-CLI context) is varied while token budget is explicitly held constant via the BCY@B metric -- the cleanest budget-matched ablation in this batch.

title: VulnGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection

key_numbers.metric: Failures attributable to missing/mislocalized vulnerable files or lines

budget_tradeoff_detail: No explicit token-budget-vs-quality tradeoff curve reported; agents are given context windows of at least 256K tokens (Sec 4.1) and explore repos via unindexed shell commands, but the paper does not quantify how detection/localization quality changes as a function of budget size.
confound_note: Central comparisons vary model (Qwen3.5 2B/4B/9B/27B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, MiniMax-M3) AND agent scaffold (Claude Code, OpenHands, MiniSWE) simultaneously across the same benchmark tasks -- capability, scaffold, and effective exploration budget all confound together; no single-factor ablation isolates representation or mechanism alone.
